_doc: Radio (UMareAudioWorld, UMareHomeWorld; Sergio 07/11: 'coloque opção de mudar música no rádio, um na casa, no quiosque e no hotel'). stations: the dial in order (id = audio.json sound, name shown in the phone and on the sets; 'off' = switched off), used by the phone's Rádio card (anterior / próxima / desligar) for the background radio. The first 10 stations are always loaded; the others (the CC0 Open Lo-Fi tracks, tools/ue58/radio_tracks.json) are streamed only while tuned. stereos: the physical sets; E on one plays the next track there (after the last one it switches off): id, action (ServiceTarget, must start with 'Home'), at [x, y, z] world cm (z = 0: placed on the first surface found tracing down from probe cm, default 220: above the counter, under the roof), boombox = spawn the boombox model (the house has its own), yaw, unlock (expansion that must be owned, empty = always), default = track when first switched on.
